overview.description: Indian students studying abroad - comprehensive statistics from multiple sources

total_indian_students_abroad.source: India Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), via Lok Sabha Question No. 894
total_indian_students_abroad.note: MEA tracks students registered with Indian missions abroad. Includes higher education only unless noted.

bureau_of_immigration_outbound.source: Bureau of Immigration, India (annual departures on student visas)
bureau_of_immigration_outbound.note: Counts departures in a given year, not stock of students abroad. Pandemic distorted 2020-2021.

unesco_uis_outbound_mobile.note: Outbound internationally mobile students from India enrolled in tertiary education abroad.

open_doors_iie.source: IIE Open Doors Report (academic year enrollment)
open_doors_iie.note: Academic years shown as ending year (e.g. 2011 = 2010/11). India became #1 origin country in 2024, surpassing China for first time since 2009.

notes.2023: 35% increase YoY, India overtook China as #1 origin
notes.2025: 30.8% of all 1,177,766 international students in US

sevis_active_records.source: SEVP/ICE SEVIS data (active F/M visa student records at snapshot date)
sevis_active_records.note: Point-in-time counts of active student records. Higher than Open Doors because includes OPT, language training, etc.

fall_2024_snapshot.note: Fall census enrollment (different from full-year Open Doors count)
fall_2024_snapshot.note2: 24% decrease from Fall 2023; China reclaimed #1 for fall census

ircc_study_permits.source: Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) - Study permit holders with valid permit on Dec 31
ircc_study_permits.note: Year-end stock of valid study permit holders from India

hesa_enrollment.source: HESA Higher Education Student Statistics (academic year, shown as ending year)
hesa_enrollment.note: India was #1 origin country in UK in 2023/24, surpassing China. Down 15% in 2024.

student_visa_grants.note: Sponsored study entry clearance visa grants (main applicants only)
student_visa_grants.note2: 2025 is partial (Q1-Q3). 307% growth from 2019 to 2022 peak.

graduate_route.note: Indian nationals = 46% of all Graduate Route visa grants. Launched July 2021.

australia.source_notes: Australian Dept of Education + MEA data

2020.note: 83% decline in new student visas due to border closure

australia.share_of_international_2025: 17% of all international students (2nd after China at 23%)

germany.note: India is now the largest origin country for international students in Germany, surpassing China.

new_zealand.note: 2nd largest source country after China. +99% growth in 2023, +49% in 2024.

other_countries_mea_2024.note: From MEA Lok Sabha answers and Wikipedia compilation. Numbers are approximate stock counts.

medical_students_abroad.source: Multiple: NMC/FMGE data, University World News, MEA
medical_students_abroad.note: An estimated 25,000 Indian students pursue MBBS abroad annually. India has ~112,000 domestic medical seats for 2.3M+ NEET applicants.

fmge_data.source: National Medical Commission (NMC) / National Board of Examinations
fmge_data.description: Foreign Medical Graduate Examination - required for Indian citizens with foreign medical degrees to practice in India

Russia.note: Largest single destination for Indian medical students

Georgia.note: MEA 2024 figure includes all students, majority medical

Philippines.note: MEA 2024 figure, includes medical and other programs

China.note: MEA 2024 figure; was 23,198 in 2023 pre-pandemic recovery. Many were MBBS students.

Ukraine.note: Sharply reduced from ~20,000 pre-2022 due to war. 18,000 evacuated in Feb 2022.
